cards.ex: She's studying culinary arts at a prestigious school in Paris.
cards.exUz: U Parijdagi nufuzli maktabda pazandalik san'atini o'rganmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ovqat tayyorlash, bezash va taqdim etish bilan bog'liq san'at turi.

cards.ex: The food critic's review was so harsh, the restaurant almost closed down.
cards.exUz: Taom tanqidchisining sharhi juda qattiq bo'lgani uchun restoran deyarli yopilib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Restoran va taomlar haqida fikr bildiruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: This chocolate cake is to die for! You have to try it.
cards.exUz: Bu shokoladli tort juda mazali! Siz buni tatib ko'rishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik mazali, bahosiga arziydi.

cards.ex: The recipe calls for three eggs and a cup of milk.
cards.exUz: Retseptda uchta tuxum va bir stakan sut kerak.
cards.uzDef: Retsept bo'yicha, ma'lum mahsulot yoki miqdor talab etiladi.

cards.ex: Add a dash of soy sauce for extra flavor.
cards.exUz: Qo'shimcha ta'm uchun bir chimdim soya sousi qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Juda oz miqdordagi narsa, odatda suyuqlik yoki ziravor.

cards.ex: We're having a bake sale to raise money for the school trip.
cards.exUz: Maktab sayohati uchun pul yig'ish maqsadida pishiriq sotuvi o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Pishiriqlar sotiladigan tadbir, odatda xayriya uchun.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
cards.exUz: Men shakar iste'molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatda ma'lum bir mahsulotni kamroq iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: Food pairing is essential for a successful wine tasting.
cards.exUz: Taom mosligi muvaffaqiyatli vino ta'mini tatib ko'rish uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mlarni uyg'unlashtirish uchun ovqat va ichimliklarni moslashtirish.

cards.ex: I can whip something up for dinner in about 30 minutes.
cards.exUz: Men kechki ovqatni taxminan 30 daqiqada tezda tayyorlay olaman.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan ovqat tayyorlash.

cards.ex: He's a seasoned chef with over 20 years of experience.
cards.exUz: U 20 yildan ortiq tajribaga ega tajribali oshpaz.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillik tajribaga ega oshpaz.

cards.ex: I use a food processor to make pesto.
cards.exUz: Men pesto tayyorlash uchun ovqat maydalagichdan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Sabzavotlarni maydalash va aralashtirish uchun elektr jihoz.

cards.ex: Don't play with your food, eat it!
cards.exUz: Ovqat bilan o'ynamang, uni yeng!
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni yemasdan, uni bilan o'ynash.

cards.ex: I had a taste of the soup, and it was delicious.
cards.exUz: Men sho'rvadan bir ta'm oldim va u juda mazali edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni ozgina tatib ko'rish.

cards.ex: We went to a cooking demonstration at the local market.
cards.exUz: Biz mahalliy bozorda pazandalik namoyishiga bordik.
cards.uzDef: Oshpazning ovqat tayyorlash jarayonini ko'rsatishi.

cards.ex: They say it's a great idea, but the proof is in the pudding.
cards.exUz: Ular bu ajoyib g'oya deyishadi, lekin ish natijada bilinadi.
cards.term: the proof is in the pudding
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir qiymati faqat amalda sinovdan o'tganda bilinadi.

cards.ex: Sorbet is often used as a palette cleanser between courses.
cards.exUz: Sorbet ko'pincha taomlar orasida ta'mni tozalagich sifatida ishlatiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mlarni tozalash uchun mo'ljallangan narsa.

cards.ex: I had to put my cooking plans on hold because I got sick.
cards.exUz: Kasal bo'lganim sababli, ovqat tayyorlash rejalashtirishni kechiktirishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtincha to'xtatib qo'ymoq, keyinroq bajarish uchun.

cards.ex: This is my grandmother's family recipe for apple pie.
cards.exUz: Bu mening buvimning olma pirogi uchun oilaviy retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan-avlodga o'tadigan retsept.

cards.ex: She always knows the latest food trends.
cards.exUz: U har doim eng so'nggi taom trendlarini biladi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi vaqtlarda ommabop bo'lgan ovqatlar.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'm not cooking tonight.
cards.exUz: O'zimni biroz kasalmand his qilyapman, shuning uchun bugun ovqat tayyorlamayman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal.

cards.ex: I'm on a diet, so I'm avoiding sweets.
cards.exUz: Men dietadaman, shuning uchun shirinliklardan qochaman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir ovqatlanish rejimiga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: Chocolate cake is my guilty pleasure.
cards.exUz: Shokoladli tort - mening yashirin zavqim.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlik hissi bilan yoqadigan narsa.

cards.ex: Make sure to clear your plate before asking for dessert.
cards.exUz: Desert so'rashdan oldin idishingizni bo'shatib oling.
cards.uzDef: Idishdagi barcha ovqatni yeb tugating.

cards.ex: First, bring the water to a boil before adding the pasta.
cards.exUz: Avval makaronni qo'shishdan oldin suvni qaynatib oling.
cards.uzDef: Suyuqlikni juda issiq holatga keltirib, qaynashni boshlash.

cards.ex: The recipe says to cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
cards.exUz: Retseptda sariyog 'va shakarni yengil va mayin bo'lguncha aralashtirish kerak deyilgan.
cards.uzDef: Yog' va shakarni birgalikda silliq massaga aylantirish.

cards.ex: Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
cards.exUz: Sovuq sariyog'ni aralashma qo'pol uvoqlarga o'xshaguncha maydalang.
cards.uzDef: Sariyog'ni un bilan pichoq yoki maxsus asbob yordamida aralashtirish.

cards.ex: Gently fold in the whipped cream to avoid deflating it.
cards.exUz: Ko'pirtirilgan qaymoqni kamaytirmaslik uchun uni asta-sekin eging va aralashtiring.
cards.uzDef: Yengil ingredientni og'irrog'iga ehtiyotkorlik bilan aralashtirish.

cards.ex: That documentary about sustainable food production gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Barqaror oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarish haqidagi hujjatli film menga o'ylash uchun ko'p sabab berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga undaydigan, muhokama qilishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: She's always full of beans in the morning, even before her coffee.
cards.exUz: U har doim ertalab, hatto kofe ichishdan oldin ham g'ayratga to'la bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'ayratli, faol, kuchga to'la.

cards.ex: Some people see government contracts as a gravy train.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar hukumat shartnomalarini oson daromad manbai deb bilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Oson va kam mehnat bilan keladigan katta daromad manbai.
